GETAWAY / DOCS

THE DRIVER’S
HANDBOOK.

Pick up the crew. Drop them somewhere safe. Make it back to the garage with your haul.

GETAWAY is a solo arcade driving game you play in your browser. You start inside your own apartment with a guided first-night tutorial. The 150-second shift timer begins when you leave for the car. Deliveries add time and credits, while riskier pickups bring more attention from the police.

YOUR HAUL ISN’T SAFE YET

Credits from a run are unbanked until you stop at Last Exit Garage and bank them. Getting caught, wrecking your car, or running out of time ends the run and loses the unbanked haul.

01

YOUR FIRST RUN

  1. Open the game inside your apartment. Walk around using W A S D, the arrow keys, or the direction buttons on a phone.
  2. Walk to the glowing marker by the laptop. Press E or tap the action button to read your first job.
  3. Head to the entry door on the right and interact. Your first ride, The Workhorse, is waiting downstairs at Last Exit.
  4. Follow the mint route arrows to a pickup. The dispatch panel tells you where to go.
  5. Stop inside the pickup ring until the boarding bar fills.
  6. Follow the route to your passenger’s hideout. Stop inside the destination ring to complete the delivery.
  7. Choose Route to garage or press Tab. Stop at Last Exit, then press E or tap Bank your haul.

Your first shift routes you to the diner, then to a hideout, then back to the garage. The tutorial tracks each step and remembers your progress.

YOUR APARTMENT

The laptop has your briefing. The wardrobe opens car and paint selection. The bedside marker saves progress. The entry door starts a shift or resumes the one you saved. No shift time passes while you are home.

ON A PHONE

At home, use the direction buttons to walk and the action button to interact. In the car, hold the steering and gas buttons together. Brake slows the car before reversing. Drift and nitro have their own buttons, and the on-screen pause button opens the menu.

Nitro refills when you release it. If you get stuck, use Recover car in the pause menu. Recovery moves you to a nearby road; it doesn’t clear your wanted level.

03

JOBS & DELIVERIES

There are twelve pickup spots and ten possible hideouts. Open Jobs to choose a fare. Your car’s seat count limits how many passengers you can carry.

JobBase fareRisk
Late shift850 CRLower
Hot pickup1,450 CRMedium
Big score2,100 CRHigh

A successful pickup adds 10 seconds. A delivery adds 40 seconds, up to a maximum of 180 seconds remaining. Deliveries increase your streak multiplier by 0.25, up to ×3. The first delivery pays the base fare.

Tap a passenger’s destination in the HUD to route there. Once your seats are full, drop someone off before taking another job.

04

POLICE & PURSUIT

The stars show how much attention you’ve attracted. Riskier jobs bring more heat. Police chase your car, and roadblocks can appear as a run gets more dangerous.

Break their line of sight using city blocks and shortcuts. Watch the escape meter while officers search your last known position. Avoid getting boxed in: the bust meter fills when police keep you trapped.

Drift to take a tight corner, then straighten up before using nitro. Your integrity meter shows how much damage your car can still take.

05

GARAGE & UPGRADES

Use the wardrobe in your apartment to open the garage and open your collection of rides, car skins, and drivers. The original cars use banked credits; special rides and cosmetics have a burn-to-unlock preview.

RideSeatsIntegrityUnlock
The Workhorse3120Free
Night Runner21006,000 CR
Redline19014,000 CR
Alley Cat2852,500 demo tokens
Night Cab41154,000 demo tokens
Ironhide31656,000 demo tokens

The Workhorse carries more passengers and takes more damage. Night Runner balances pace and capacity. Redline is the quickest ride, with room for one passenger. Alley Cat turns quickly in tight streets. Night Cab carries four passengers. Ironhide has the most integrity. Car skins change appearance without changing these stats.

Banking ends your current shift and lets you return to your apartment. Your banked credits and best run appear at home. A car selected while a shift is saved applies to your next new shift; resuming keeps the original car.

05 / COLLECTION

SKINS & BURN UNLOCKS

BURN PREVIEW — NO REAL TOKENS

Your collection starts with 25,000 demo tokens. They have no cash value. Demo burns never open a wallet or send a blockchain transaction. Demo ownership saves on this device and does not become a live wallet entitlement.

  1. Use the wardrobe at home to open your collection.
  2. Choose Rides, Car skins, or Drivers. Select a card to inspect its actual game model.
  3. Choose Burn demo tokens. Review the cost, balance, and item before confirming.
  4. The item unlocks and equips immediately. Drivers appear in your apartment; car skins apply to your ride. New cars are used on the next fresh shift.
ItemTypePreview cost
AfterglowMint car skin600 demo tokens
MidnightViolet car skin1,200 demo tokens
HeatwaveOrange car skin1,800 demo tokens
Ghost ChromeSilver car skin2,500 demo tokens
Night BanditDriver900 demo tokens
Off DutyDriver1,400 demo tokens

WHEN TOKEN BURNS GO LIVE

Real burns require the announced token and a deployed unlock contract. The wallet flow reads the price from the contract, requests an exact token approval, and then requests the burn. The contract checks that the token supply and your balance both fell by the required amount before it grants the item. Ownership belongs to the connected wallet; these unlocks are not transferable NFTs.

Real burns are not enabled in this release. Preview prices can change before launch. Your original driver, factory paint, and credit-based cars remain available without token burns.

06

LEARN THE STREETS

DOWNTOWN

Union Trust and The Regent sit on the north road. The market is to the northeast. Main streets connect through a compact grid.

NEON ROW

The records store and arcade line the center alley. Motel 86 sits to the west and the Grand Hotel to the east. Watch for the alley ramp.

LAST EXIT

The garage is on the southeast road. The 24-hour diner is nearby. The west-side pawn shop and laundromat hide another ramp shortcut.

BEYOND DOWNTOWN

Head north to Central Station and Starlight Cinema. The west road reaches Port Authority and Pier Market. Riverside Park and North Gardens bring green space to the outer districts. Follow the southern road to the motor yards and Roadhouse.

The playable area is more than twice the size of the original map, with 36 junctions linking the expanded road grid.

07

SAVING PROGRESS

Your tutorial progress, apartment position, banked credits, unlocked cars, equipped skins and driver, demo collection balance, paint, best run, and preferences save in this browser on this device.

An unfinished shift also saves: your car, passengers, remaining time, wanted level, and unbanked haul. Progress saves every three seconds during play and when you leave the page. For an immediate save, open the driving pause menu and choose Save & return home, or use the bedside marker in your apartment.

When you reopen the game, you start at home. Use the door or Resume saved shift to continue. The timer stays paused at home. Saving a shift does not bank its haul; you must still bring it to Last Exit. Finishing or restarting replaces that saved shift.

Use the same browser to keep playing with your saved profile. Clearing site data or using a different browser or device won’t carry that progress over. Private browsing may not retain your save.

08

CURRENT BUILD

The current game includes a furnished apartment you can walk around, a guided tutorial, resumable shifts, solo driving, AI traffic and police, pickups and deliveries, ramps, destructible props, six playable cars, car skins, driver selection, demo burn unlocks, and local saves.

Credits are in-game arcade points with no cash value. Live token burns, on-chain rewards, and multiplayer are not enabled in this build.
